goal: Allows running transaction indexing concurrently with block pruning on storage-constrained nodes.
Enables transaction lookups without needing hundreds of gigabytes of raw block history on disk.
Surfaces missing block hashes so callers can fetch needed pruned blocks on demand.
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now, as no pending rebase or blocking redesign invalidates review.
agreement: Strong support for allowing txindex to run alongside pruning without open objections (ajtowns, arejula27)
Resolved concern about already-pruned nodes by supporting partial indexing from oldest block (mzumsande)
Resolved interface concern by returning missing block hashes in structured RPC error data (arejula27)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because storage-constrained nodes can index transactions without keeping full block history on disk.
Allows starting a partial index on an already-pruned node and indexing future transactions.

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because RPC and REST errors return structured candidate block hashes when lookups hit pruned blocks.
Enables downstream applications to automate fetching missing blocks on demand.
